transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm just... I guess I'm here because I can't really get out of my own head lately. It's just this constant feeling that I've... that I've failed. As a father. As a person who's supposed to be useful. It just loops and loops, and... well, it makes me feel like I don't really deserve much of a future.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things anymore that you used to find pleasurable, like hobbies, time with family, or other activities?

Yeah... I guess so. 

I used to look forward to things. Like... working on the model railway. Or watching Cubs games with my daughter. 

But lately... I don't know. The trains just sit there on the table, half-built. I haven't touched them. And even turning on the TV for a game just... it feels pointless. So, yeah. I don't really do much of that anymore.
Do you find yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things, even when it's not entirely your fault?

I mean... yeah. Like I said when I first sat down. I just can't really shake the feeling that I've completely failed. As a father, and... just as someone who's actually useful. 

I don't know who else to blame for it but myself. It just keeps looping in my head, over and over. It... it just makes me feel like I don't really deserve any kind of future.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or unable to sit still?
Not really... I haven't noticed anything like that. I just... I don't do much of anything these days, so... I don't know. I guess I just sit there.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the low mood and loss of interest in things?
I guess... about a month. Give or take. It started right around the time my daughter left for college... she went out of state. So... yeah. About a month.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, or on the contrary, do you find yourself sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah... sleep hasn't been great. 

I just... I lie in bed for hours. The house is just too quiet now. And if I do finally drift off, I always wake up around three or four in the morning. 

I can't get back to sleep after that. My mind just starts running through... well, just everything I've messed up. So, yeah. I don't sleep much.
Have you had any thoughts about ending your life or that life isn't worth living?

I... I don't know. I mean... sometimes. 

Sometimes I just think... maybe it would just be easier if I didn't wake up at all. Just... stop dealing with it. 

I actually... I was looking at my bank accounts the other day. Just going through the finances. And I realized I was... I was kind of organizing them. Like I was getting things ready for someone else to take over. That... that scared me a little. But... yeah.
